question: Which Neo4j API surface is 'Neo4j' for the toolkit? Two different products/APIs share the name.

aura_management_api.what: REST API to manage Aura instances/projects (create, get, list, pause, update)

evidence.quote: The Aura API allows you to programmatically perform actions on your Aura instances without the need to log in to the Console.
Before using the API, you must follow the steps outlined in Authentication to create

aura_management_api.auth: credentials created per the Aura 'Authentication' page (page not retrieved) - mechanism unconfirmed
aura_management_api.access: needs an Aura account; free trial gives $150 credits on Professional/Business Critical; tier availability of the API not stated in retrieved pages

database_query_api.what: HTTPS endpoint executing Cypher statements against a Neo4j database (supersedes the deprecated HTTP API); separate from Bolt drivers

evidence.quote: The Query API allows to execute Cypher statements against a Neo4j server through HTTP requests.
This API supersedes the deprecated HTTP API.

database_query_api.auth: DB user credentials, basic or bearer (stated for the legacy HTTP API page; Query API authorize page not retrieved)
database_query_api.access: no developer registration: requires a reachable database (self-managed, or Aura if the Query API is available there - not stated in retrieved text); disabled by default on self-managed <5.25

composio_coverage.targets: Aura management API only (instance + project tools; several are v1beta endpoints)
composio_coverage.limitation: catalog metadata search only (3 queries); absence of a Query-API toolkit is not proof it does not exist

status: HELD - decision needed: research as two separate rows (aura_management_api, database_query_api) or pick one; the 100-app count would not change if reported as sub-rows
